scripts.setup: uv sync --project apps/api && uv sync --project packages/portfolio-risk --extra dev && bun install
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --port 8000
scripts.setup:analysts: uv sync --project apps/api --all-extras && uv run --no-sync --project apps/api python scripts/analysts.py configure
scripts.dev:analysts: uv run --no-sync --project apps/api python scripts/analysts.py serve
scripts.check:analysts: uv run --no-sync --project apps/api python scripts/check_goose_analyst.py --provider openrouter
scripts.check:analysts:live: uv run --no-sync --project apps/api python scripts/check_goose_analyst.py --provider openrouter --live
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.worker:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 --workers 1
scripts.db:init: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.storage_admin init-demo
scripts.build:native: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/build_native.py && uv run --project apps/api python scripts/build_ledger_native.py && uv run --project apps/api --with libclang --with cmake python scripts/build_decision_native.py
scripts.test: bun run test:py && bun run test:mcp && bun run test:native-service && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:py: bun run check:architecture && bun run test:engine && bun run test:api
scripts.test:e2e: cd apps/web && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:e2e -- -c playwright.cohorts.config.ts && bun run test:e2e -- -c playwright.stream.config.ts && bun run test:e2e -- -c playwright.native.config.ts
scripts.test:mcp: uv run --project apps/mcp --extra dev python -m pytest apps/mcp/tests -q && cd apps/api && uv run --extra dev --with-editable ../mcp python -m pytest tests/test_agent_routes.py tests/test_agent_mcp_integration.py -q
scripts.test:native-service: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/api-rust/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path apps/api-rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets --features s3,fault-injection -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --manifest-path apps/api-rust/Cargo.toml --features fault-injection
scripts.test:engine: cd packages/portfolio-risk && uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/ -q
scripts.check:architecture: python scripts/check_agent_contract.py && python scripts/check_architecture.py && python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -v && python scripts/generate_native_contracts.py --check && uv run --project apps/api python scripts/generate_http_contracts.py --check && uv run --project apps/api python scripts/generate_mcp_contracts.py --check
